heroSub: In the project implemented for Stackpole, operation-level traceability was established throughout production, improving process visibility and quality assurance.
contextTitle: Central traceability for uninterrupted production flow
contextP1: In the Stackpole production environment, the goal was to track products individually across production steps, protect operation sequence integrity, and centrally manage process data.
contextP2: The project created real-time visibility for quality and operations teams by making product history traceable from production to shipment.
problemTitle: Risk of tracking gaps across operations
problemLede: Inability to track product movement reliably at individual level across operations created risks for process control and quality validation.

problemList.text: Lack of real-time status visibility during operation transitions made follow-up difficult.
A systematic mechanism was needed to validate that products follow the correct operation sequence.
Fragmented historical records made quality review and root-cause analysis harder.

solutionLede: Products were recognized by operation in the production flow and recorded at each step in the system. This enabled end-to-end traceability of product history and strengthened operation validation.

steps.title: Product Identification
steps.text: Products were introduced into the traceability flow with unique identity.

steps.title: Operation Reading
steps.text: Product status and operation transitions were validated automatically at each station.

steps.title: Real-Time Logging
steps.text: Process data was collected in real time and stored in a central system.

steps.title: Backward Traceability
steps.text: Product history and operation chain became reportable and auditable.

techTitle: Field automation and traceability software layer

techGrid.title: Code Recognition Infrastructure
techGrid.text: Enables automatic product recognition and validation at operation points.

techGrid.title: PLC-Based Flow Control
techGrid.text: Manages operation transitions and maintains consistency in field processes.

techGrid.title: Traceability Application
techGrid.text: Collects operation data, stores product history, and provides reporting.

integrationDesc: Traceability data was structured for enterprise sharing, making product, operation, and status information centrally manageable.

integrationList.text: Product flow data is transferred to central systems, enabling one-point process monitoring.
Collected traceability data is kept ready for quality and production analytics.

resultsTitle: Improved visibility and control in Stackpole production

resultsGrid.title: End-to-End Tracking
resultsGrid.text: Products became traceable by operation across the complete production process.

resultsGrid.title: Stronger Process Control
resultsGrid.text: Operation transition validation increased production flow control capability.

resultsGrid.title: Quality Analysis Support
resultsGrid.text: Individual product history accelerated quality investigations and root-cause analysis.
